case_title: JITENDRA SINGH @ BABBOO SINGH v. STATE OF U.P.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to 7 years and 2 years imprisonment respectively with fine of Rs. 1001
neutral_facts: The accused, a married man, was involved in the death of his wife, who was 19 years old at the time of her demise. The incident occurred within seven years of her marriage, and she was subjected to cruelty and harassment by her husband for dowry-related demands. The accused was initially claimed to be a juvenile, but subsequent medical and documentary evidence established his age as 17 years at the time of the incident. The trial court convicted him under sections 304B and 498A of the IPC, sentencing him to 7 years and 2 years of imprisonment respectively, along with a fine of Rs. 1001. The High Court confirmed the conviction, and the Supreme Court upheld the conviction but remanded the matter to the Juvenile Justice Board for determining an appropriate fine.
